title: A Déspota — identidade individual e conjunto anime
style: Matriarca de cinza idosa e colossal; olhos distintos, placas de cinza na face, rosto largo e envelhecido, três arcos de tranças, ombros e braços volumosos. Contorno desenhado e cel shading anime. Mesmo rosto, corpo e acessórios em seis cenas.
export: Imagens completas exportadas para WebP 512×512; sem recorte. PNGs de geração preservados.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square original character portrait for dark supernatural Japanese ANIME 2D game Post Mortem Arena. Character: A Déspota, an oppressive ash-forged giant matriarch from Coroa, the imperial Bond of domination in Inferno. She must be unmistakably different from a slim young prince, a faceless ghost king, and a conventional glamorous anime woman. Design identity: elderly mature woman, short relative to her massive width, very broad barrel chest and neck, thick powerful upper arms, heavy square jaw and full cheeks, wide flattened nose, deep charcoal-brown skin, natural age lines drawn simply in anime style, an irregular pale ash patch around the left temple and jaw, a diagonal old burn scar crossing her LEFT eyebrow, milky opaque LEFT eye, a smaller sharp amber RIGHT eye. Hair: black and silver coarse braids, sides closely shaved, three thick upright braided arches swept back into a low heavy knot; asymmetric haircut must be very readable. Her forearms have subtle cooled-ash cracks, her hands are broad BARE hands with exactly five fingers each. Costume: blocky blackened-bronze collar and shoulder plates, deep slate-green ceremonial coat with ivory geometric inner trim, a short rigid mantle that makes a strong trapezoid silhouette, heavy iron wrist shackles. No long white braid, no curls, no thin face, no big youthful eyes, no slim waist. Three-quarter view showing head, broad shoulders, torso and one bare hand resting on the head of a massive imperial branding hammer. She regards the viewer with tired absolute authority, not rage. Background: pale ruined imperial stone courtyard with iron prison gates, drifting ash but NO sea of flames, Coroa architecture rather than a volcanic fire realm. Muted slate-green, black bronze and pale ash, amber only in one eye. Strictly graphic hand-drawn anime contour linework and crisp cel shading; NOT realism, NOT painterly concept art, NOT 3D. No text, no UI, no frame, no crown identical to another character. Coherent anatomy; full face readable at thumbnail size.
